description: Source code for RRC (Radio Resource Control) reestablishment procedure in a 5G/NR network, implementing logic for handling reestablishment requests, fallback procedures, security verification, and context management.

classes.name: rrc_reestablishment_procedure
classes.description: Class implementing the RRC reestablishment procedure, including request handling, fallback, security checks, and context management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine handling the reestablishment process, including validation, context transfer, message sending, and cleanup.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reestablishment_fallback
methods.description: Handles fallback to RRC setup if reestablishment is rejected or fails.

methods.name: is_reestablishment_accepted
methods.description: Checks whether the reestablishment request can be accepted based on context and security.

methods.name: verify_security_context
methods.description: Verifies the security context of the reestablishment request using MAC verification.

methods.name: transfer_reestablishment_context_and_update_keys
methods.description: Transfers UE context and updates security keys after successful reestablishment.

methods.name: create_srb1
methods.description: Creates and activates SRB1 for the UE.

methods.name: send_rrc_reestablishment
methods.description: Constructs and sends the RRC Reestablishment message to the UE.

methods.name: enable_srb1_ciphering
methods.description: Enables ciphering on SRB1 after message transmission.

methods.name: log_rejected_reestablishment
methods.description: Logs reasons for rejecting reestablishment requests.
